title: The Hedgehog and the Wood Pigeons
logline: A hedgehog who cannot climb plays the holy hermit to trick two wood pigeons into stripping their own date palm and walking into his burrow; cornered, the male pigeon starts telling a story.
moral: A show of piety can hide an appetite, and a trick tends to come back on the one who plays it.
tone: Sly comedy of a fake saint that tightens into a real trap, then an open, uneasy ending held on a storyteller buying time. The menace is comic-book (teeth, shadow), never bloody.

beats.summary: A pigeon couple lives in the crown of a tall date palm and eats its fruit.
The hedgehog below wants the dates and cannot climb.
He digs a burrow by the trunk and fakes a holy, simple life.
Thirty years of devotion, he says, eating only what falls.
His advice: shake down every date, store a year of food, live by the ground.
The pigeons strip the tree; he hides the whole harvest in his burrow.
His real plan: hunger will bring them close enough to catch and eat.
The dates are gone; he blames the wind and preaches patience.
Talked round, they enter his burrow as friends.
He blocks the door and shows his teeth: a trap.
The male pigeon warns that deceit returns upon the deceiver.
The tale of the two cheats who poisoned each other while the merchant lived.
Open ending: the hedgehog listens at the door; the pigeons are still shut in.

subtitles.ar: عاش زوج من الحمام البري فوق نخلة عالية،|وكان يأكل من تمرها كل يوم.|تحت النخلة سكن قنفذ مع زوجته.|نظر إلى الثمر وتمنى أن يحصل عليه، لكنه لم يستطع صعود الشجرة.
subtitles.en: A pair of wood pigeons lived high in a date palm,|eating its fruit daily.|Below them a hedgehog and his wife|wanted the dates but could not climb the tree.

subtitles.ar: حفر القنفذ جحرًا قرب الجذع،|وجلس أمامه متظاهرًا بالصلاة والزهد.|رآه ذكر الحمام فسأله عن حياته.|قال القنفذ إنه يعيش هكذا منذ ثلاثين سنة، ولا يأكل إلا ما يسقط من التمر.
subtitles.en: The hedgehog dug a burrow by the trunk|and pretended to pray and live simply.|Asked about his life,|he claimed thirty years of devotion and eating only fallen dates.

subtitles.ar: أعجب الحمام بكلامه،|وطلب نصيحته ليعيش حياة بسيطة هو وزوجته.|قال القنفذ: «أسقطا تمر النخلة كله، واجمعا طعام سنة كاملة،|ثم اسكنا قرب الأرض واقضيا وقتكما في العبادة».
subtitles.en: Impressed,|the pigeon asked for guidance.|The hedgehog advised the couple to shake down the dates, save enough for a year,|move near the ground and devote themselves to worship.

subtitles.ar: عمل الحمامان ساعات طويلة حتى أسقطا جميع الثمر.|لكن القنفذ أخذ التمر إلى جحره وخبأه لنفسه.|كان ينتظر أن يجوع الطائران فيقتربا منه،|حتى يستطيع الإمساك بهما وأكلهما.
subtitles.en: The pigeons worked until all the fruit fell.|The hedgehog secretly stored it in his burrow,|hoping hunger would bring them near|enough for him to catch and eat.

subtitles.ar: عندما نزلا لم يجدا شيئًا من التمر.|سألا القنفذ عنه، فأجاب أن الريح ربما حملته بعيدًا.|ثم أخذ يحدثهما عن الصبر والتوكل،|ويتظاهر بأنه لا يهتم بالطعام.
subtitles.en: Descending, the pigeons found no dates.|The hedgehog claimed the wind had carried them away|and lectured them about patience and trust|while pretending to care little for food.

subtitles.ar: صدقه الحمامان بعد طول حديث، ودخلا جحره وهما يظنان أنه صديق صالح.|عندئذ أسرع القنفذ إلى الباب وسد طريق الخروج،|وأظهر أسنانه الحادة.|أدرك الحمام أنهما وقعا في فخ.
subtitles.en: After long persuasion, the pigeons trusted him and entered his burrow.|The hedgehog rushed to block the exit|and bared his teeth.|They realized it was a trap.

subtitles.ar: قال ذكر الحمام: «بالأمس كنت تنصحنا بالخير، واليوم تريد قتلنا!|ألا تخشى أن يعود مكرك عليك؟»|ثم ذكر رجلين حاولا خداع تاجر،|لكن كل واحد منهما خطط لخيانة صاحبه.
subtitles.en: The male pigeon protested: “Yesterday you advised us; today you wish to kill us!|Do you not fear your deceit returning upon you?”|He mentioned two cheats who planned to betray a merchant|and each other.

subtitles.ar: سأل القنفذ عن قصة الرجلين،|فبدأ الحمام يروي كيف وضع كل محتال السم في طعام الآخر، فماتا وبقي التاجر حيًا.|ظل القنفذ عند باب الجحر يستمع إلى الحكاية،|بينما كان الحمامان محاصرين في الداخل.
subtitles.en: The hedgehog asked for the story.|The pigeon told how each cheat poisoned the other’s food, both died and the merchant survived.|The hedgehog listened at the burrow’s entrance|while the pigeons remained trapped inside.

new_assets.name: hedgehog
new_assets.description: Side-view comic hedgehog for this and any later hedgehog or porcupine tale (palette option). Feet at (x, y), facing dir. On all fours at s 1: 200 wide x 130 tall. Sitting or rearing upright: 150 wide x 180 tall. Cream face and belly, brown spine coat, black nose on a pointed snout, round ear, short legs with paws. pal 1 = the wife (lighter coat, red bow). Pose fields: ph, amp (walk), sit 0..1, rear 0..1, curl 0..1 (ball), roll 0..1 (on his back), dig (phase), spike 0..1 (spines raised and 40 % longer), carry n (dates stuck on the spines), paws (named sets: clasp, chest, open, up, point, wide, hold, rub, pat, reach, chin, cheeks, ear, belly, mouth) or pawL/pawR targets, talk, mouth (closed, smile, smirk, frown, o, open, grin, teeth), teeth 0..1, lick, cheeks (puff), chew, sniff, brow, lidL/lidR (per-eye lids for the wink and the peek), plus the shared acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: One function hedgehog(ctx, P) in Library/cast, wrapped with acting(). Body: a brush-outlined dome (K ellipse/rounded path) in brown with red-brown dot shading; spine coat = 3 rows of 9 to 11 tapering triangles along the back arc, each 26 to 34 long (x1.4 at spike 1), angles fanned from the arc normal with a seeded +-0.12 rad jitter and a follow-through offset P.spineLag. Face wedge in cream with eye2() eyes so gaze/lid/wet work; per-eye lids by drawing the lid arc per eye. Sit/rear blend rotates the body about the hips from horizontal to upright (like the fox sit) and moves the two front paws to arm IK targets (armTo with segment length 34). curl draws a circle of radius 78 with the spine rows all round and only the nose showing. teeth: mouth polygon opened wide with two rows of 5 white triangles, 9 high. carry: n date ellipses drawn at seeded spine tips.

new_assets.name: burrowChamber
new_assets.description: Cutaway underground room for any den, burrow or cave interior. World 1000 x 1230, floor y 900. Brown earth with dark dot shading fills the frame; a rounded cavity (x 110..930, y 500..930, navy-brown interior with blue dots) is cut into it. Door arch on the left: x 150..320, 190 high, showing sky by option doorSky u (skyCycle). Five hanging roots from the ceiling; a curtain of 6 root strands at x 800..920 hiding an alcove with a date hoard (option hoard 0..1, spill n). Options: dark 0..1 (navy overlay with the door light cone left clear), shadow (a polygon cast on the floor from an actor outline toward +x).
new_assets.implementation: bake() the earth and cavity once (K path with brush outline, halftone dots clipped to the cavity). Door arch: clip region, draw skyCycle(ctx, u) reduced inside it, then a pale yellow dotted light cone on the floor (a quadrilateral from the arch base to x 700). dark: fillRect navy with globalAlpha, drawn before the actors' rim. shadow: take 12 spine tip points of the hedgehog, project along the floor with a 3.2x horizontal stretch and 0.18 vertical scale, fill black alpha 0.55. Based on the Fox drawInside cross-section idea.

new_assets.name: palmGrove (with palmTree)
new_assets.description: The outdoor set: the planned palmTree (KD-016) made tall, on Library sky, hillTrees and ground. palmTree(ctx, 400, 900, {h: 620, lean: 10, fronds: 9}): trunk 60 wide at the base tapering to 44, ringed segments; crown hub at about (410, 280), fronds 260 long; a flat ledge of cut frond bases at y 262..268 (x 330..520) where the pigeons perch; a low stub on the trunk from (430, 650) to (600, 640), 16 thick, that dips 6 units under a landing. Home bush (Library bush) at x 160. Sky by skyCycle(u).
new_assets.implementation: Compose from existing sky/skyCycle, hillTrees, ground, bush; reuse the planned palmTree drawing with new opts (ledge: true, stub: {y: 650, len: 170}). Fronds: 9 bezier ribs with leaflet strokes, sway = sin(t * 0.8 + i) * 0.03 rad. Bake the trunk; draw the fronds live for the sway.

new_assets.name: dateBunch, datePile
new_assets.description: dateBunch(ctx, x, y, {left, shake, swing, seed}): a hanging cluster 70 wide x 110 tall: yellow stalk fan of 7 strands from the crown, up to 14 dates (red-brown ellipses 14 x 22 with a highlight) of which left 0..1 remain; bare stalks when 0. datePile(ctx, x, y, {n, seed}): n 0..40 dates stacked as a mound up to 260 wide x 110 high, plus single loose dates. Reusable for any palm, market or food scene.
new_assets.implementation: Seeded positions (K.rng) fixed per date so removing a date never moves the others; pile positions precomputed in layers (row widths 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 3, 2). Falling dates are scene code: fallY + rebound from a bunch point to its pile slot.

new_assets.name: dove (bird kind)
new_assets.description: The planned dove kind on the Library bird, with a wood pigeon palette: pal 1 male (blue-grey body, darker head, white neck patch with a green edge, pink chest), pal 2 female (8 % smaller, paler, no green). Uses the planned puff field (feathers out in fear, chest out in courage).
new_assets.implementation: Palette entries in BIRD plus the neck patch (a small white ellipse) and puff (body ellipse scaled 1.12 with 6 notches in the outline).

new_assets.name: burrow
new_assets.description: The planned burrow mound, here 220 wide x 100 high centred x 880 with a dark opening 100 x 80 centred x 815; states grow 0..1 (three steps while it is dug) and eyes (two glints in the dark).
new_assets.implementation: Planned asset; add grow as a vertical scale with a clod ring, opening drawn last so actors can be clipped into it.

new_assets.name: poisonVial
new_assets.description: Small green bottle 18 x 30 with a cork and a plain X label, with a tilt angle and 3 drops when poured. For the tale inside the story cloud.
new_assets.implementation: Rounded rect + neck + cork; drops are 3 ellipses on fallY.

owner_questions: The hedgehog's wife is named only in paragraph 1; default: she also appears as a pair of paws at the burrow helping to hide the dates (S8, S9).
The pretend prayer is shown as a generic pose (paws clasped, eyes shut, head bowed, gentle sway) with no prayer mat, beads or ritual of any faith; default: keep it generic.
The plan to catch and eat the pigeons is shown only in a thought cloud (paws clap, a puff, a plate with two feathers) and the teeth are comic, with no blood; default: this softened version.
The deaths of the two cheats are shown as closed eyes and tipping over, with a plain X on the bottle and the label POISON, no skull; default: this softened version.
The script stops with the pigeons still trapped; default: an open ending under THE END (not TO BE CONTINUED), with the pigeon still talking.

Added comic business not in the script: dates carried stuck on his spines, the date left on his back during the sermon, the swallowed burp, the still fronds during the wind excuse; default: keep all four.

Invented lettering: WOOD PIGEONS, SO HIGH, HEDGEHOG, THUD!, JUST AN ACT, 30 YEARS, WOW!, ALL!, 1 YEAR, ALL MINE, NEXT MORNING..., ?, YAK YAK YAK, SHINK!, TRAP!, MERCHANT, AND THEN?, POISON, ALIVE!, HA HA!, ONLY WAY OUT, THE END; default: keep (cut HE tag and ONLY WAY OUT first if it feels busy).
implementation_notes: Copy Library/template to Animations/AN-043 and take every cue from timing.json words; the cue times in this plan are the word starts in planning/inputs/timeline.md.
Two worlds, both 1000 x 1230 with ground/floor at y 900: palmGrove (S1 to S11) and burrowChamber (S12 to S17). The cut at 116.5 happens in the dark of the opening.
Set LIFE.t = t every frame for auto-blinks; give the hedgehog explicit lids only where the plan says (prayer, peek, wink, the no-blink teeth close-up).
The mask rule: the hedgehog shows his real face (smirk, open eyes, teeth) only when no pigeon is looking at him, until 120.66; after that the mask never returns.
The two pigeons never move in unison except the last tug at 72.52; the female always reacts 5 to 10 frames after the male.
Sky is one skyCycle value u keyed with kfn: 0.25 (S1 to S6), 0.22 to 0.47 (S7), 0.5 to 0.72 (S8), 0.08 after the card (S9, S10), 0.1 to 0.42 (S11), door sky 0.45 to 0.72 (S17).
LATER card: S.transition with caption NEXT MORNING..., centred on 90.3 (inside the 89.84 to 90.84 pause); put the camera cut and the sky jump 0.01 s apart at its covered midpoint.
Thought and story clouds use thoughtCloud with figures at least 110 px on screen; the S15/S16 cloud is the largest (640 x 400). Use lie + lid 1 for the fallen cheats.
Picture strip in S6 and the single balloon in S9 are the planned iconBalloon; if it is not in the Library yet, draw them as S.box panels with a tail.
Use panel-only shake (template) for THUD! at 21.4 and TRAP! at 132.2; the caption panel never moves.
Effects only at: 13.5 pop, 18.05 whoosh, 21.5 thud, 22.2 pop, 44.5 chime, 74.72 pop, 90.1 whoosh, 95.3 pop, 110.3 chime, 179.15 thud. All inside listed pauses or after the last word; master 0.6.
Keep lettering off faces and above the subtitles; counters (30 YEARS, DATES) sit top right of the picture panel.
warnings: The hedgehog is a large new figure with many pose fields; build sit/rear, paws, spike, curl and teeth first, since the story depends on them.
Subtitle chunk 2 of paragraph 8 lasts about 10 s (158.76 to 169.5) and is long on screen; chunk 3 of paragraph 3 is also long. The animator may need a smaller Arabic size for those two chunks.
The palm is 620 tall, so pigeons and hedgehog share a frame only in wide shots; the low stub (y 650) exists to make the dialogue two-shots possible.
The story ends unresolved in the script. Do not add an escape or a punishment.
The burrow interior must stay readable when darkened: keep the dark overlay at 0.4 or less and give faces a pale rim.
